title: Oostende celebrate Pro Basketball League title
description: Oostende - Mechelen 100-76 Oostende celebrated PBL title. They stormed past Mechelen in Game 4 to lift the trophy. Oostende shot the lights out from three sinking 15 long-distance shots on high 55.6 percentage. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 29 assists. American forward Timmy Allen (198-2000, college: Texas) fired 20 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Dutch guard Marijn Ververs (194-1998) chipped in a double-double by scoring 10 points, 5 rebounds and 12 assists. Oostende's coach Dario Gjergja felt very confident that he used entire bench which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. American point guard Joshua Heath (186-1994, college: Georgia Tech) produced a double-double by scoring 16 points and 11 assists and center Seppe Willems (202-1999) added 18 points and 5 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field) respectively for lost side.
